text:
sarah: Packaging for v2.7.1-private (airgap) ready for handoff. Need final checksum + signer before 18:00 UTC window. Deploy bot kicked off canary manifest build.

deploy-bot: PACKAGER: job 38129 started on builders-pack1. output: s3://redwood-private/v2.7.1/canary-manifest.json. artifact: /artifacts/v2.7.1-private.tar.gz

chen: Grabbed it. Starting sha256 checks. If all good I'll uplink to offsite mirror.

maria: Reminder: KMS rotation today at 17:45 UTC — if signer uses old key we need to requeue.

chen: Ran checks:
```
sha256sum canary-manifest.json -> 3b2f4c9e7d9a8f0b2c1d4e5f6a7b8c9dad7
sha256sum redwood-private-2.7.1.tar.gz -> 8f3e2b6c1a9d4f7e6b2c1d3a4f5c6b21c21
```

signer-bot: SIGNER: queued. Waiting for KMS token from ops. Requester: @sarah

sarah: I've requested KMS access from Tom, pinging him now.

tom: @sarah just approved temporary signer role (ttl 1h). Go ahead.

signer-bot: SIGNER: signed canary-manifest.json -> cosign sig attached. cosign:sha256:AB12CD34EF56... Ready.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: transport staging -> offsite-escort scheduled 18:00 UTC. Canary rollout window 18:15-18:45 UTC. Canary percent = 5%.

maria: Preflight checks: image pull tests pass in VPC staging, installer smoke ok on 2 hosts. No regressions in boot logs.

chen: Packing installer delta artifacts and shrinkwrap. Pushed artifacts to sealed-bucket. Offsite checksum recorded.

sarah: Decision point: if canary latency >20% or error rate >1.5% -> abort and rollback to v2.7.0. If tarball checksum mismatch during transport -> abort and republish.

tom: @deploy-bot if abort during transport, please abort and notify #eng-releases+pager.

deploy-bot: ACK. Abort triggers: transport-failure, cosign-mismatch, canary-slo-breach. On abort will revert route to v2.7.0 and create rollback ticket.

chen: One manual note: mirror operator will need the cosign sig + signed manifest. I'll send the manifest to the mirror operator channel after sign.

maria: Also adding a grace period: if signer TTL expires during handoff, we will pause and re-request — don't auto-rollback for TTL expiry alone.

sarah: Sounds good. Final check: @chen @maria confirm we have handoff checklist items in the release notes fragment.

chen: Confirmed. Pushing release_notes/private-v2.7.1.md now.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary window.

signer-bot: SIGNER: archived signature in kms-audit. Sig ID SIG-2026-0712-82.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: canary release started at 18:15:12 UTC for release v2.7.1-private. monitoring->canary-metrics: latency_p50, error_rate, attach logs.

tom: Oncall here, I'll be ready to escalate.

sarah: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short blurb to #customer-success after canary completes.
